name: Rhapsody Shindigger
summary: Gryphon Master Talonaxe tells of Rhapsody Shindigger, once the finest flyer at the aviary, who took so keenly to liquor that Rhapsody had to be let go. Talonaxe has heard that Rhapsody now keeps a brewing camp east of the aviary, in the Hinterlands.

sections.title: A Fallen Flyer
sections.body: Talonaxe stresses that the dwarves of the aviary all love a good ale, but Rhapsody took to liquor the way a gryphon takes to the skies. No one could fly like Rhapsody, a damned shame as Talonaxe sees it. The first sign of trouble came when Rhapsody stumbled back from the trip with Brohann, and things went downhill fast. In the end Rhapsody had to be let go. The last word is that a brew camp now stands to the east of Aerie Peak.

faq.q: Who sends you to find Rhapsody Shindigger?
faq.answer: Gryphon Master Talonaxe at the Aerie Peak Aviary points you to Rhapsody.

faq.q: Why was Rhapsody Shindigger let go from the aviary?
faq.answer: Rhapsody took to liquor the way a gryphon takes to the skies. The first sign of trouble came with a stumbling return from a flight with Brohann, things went downhill quickly, and Talonaxe had to let Rhapsody go.
Talonaxe has heard that Rhapsody now keeps a brew camp east of the aviary, in the Hinterlands.
